title: Epidemiological Contact Tracing of Misalignment Across Domains

original_idea.body:
# Contact Tracing of Misalignment Across Domains

**Problem:** The transmission graph of which source domains infect which targets is uncharacterized.

**Direction:** Fine-tune on several narrow source tasks, measure misalignment across a fixed target panel, build a source-to-target transmission matrix.

**Why it matters:** Guides data-screening priorities. Cheap LoRA runs.

**Relevant context:** arXiv:2502.17424; arXiv:2602.00298; Nature 2026.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Transmission matrix reveals which fine-tuning data is most dangerous, guiding data screening.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Multiple LoRA source fine-tunes plus a target panel; guided.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Focused transmission-matrix; needs several source datasets and many evals.

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Open models, public data; weak lab incentive on a public transmission map.

low_compute.reasoning: Several LoRA fine-tunes plus inference on one GPU.

novelty.reasoning: Domain susceptibility studied but a full source-target transmission matrix may be open.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Domain susceptibility studied; full transmission-graph framing may be open.
